name: River: the Range sausage (simulated)
description: Up and down the Range, the wide reach between Sandquay and Noss, north of the Higher Ferry. Two laps; legs along the river, so a beat or a run when the wind blows up or down the river. The starting area lies clear of the Sandquay pontoons, the Hindostan and Dart Marina.

provenance.notes: Invented practice course placed by the developer in deep water clear of the mooring areas, ferry tracks, piers and structures in the geodata (moved 180 m upriver on 29 Oct 2026, so that the starting area is clear of the Sandquay pontoons, the moored training ship Hindostan and Dart Marina). Not an RDYC course; marks are not real.
